extinguishant_options.mechanism_and_tradeoff: High latent heat of vaporization cools solid pyrolysis surfaces (PMMA, SIBAL, Nomex, Foam) without adding toxic cabin gas [SLICE-007, SLICE-008]. Avoid direct spray on unisolated high-voltage buses or pool liquid fuels.

extinguishant_options.agent_name: Carbon Dioxide (CO₂) Inerting Flood (36.0% Target Vol)
extinguishant_options.mechanism_and_tradeoff: Displaces O₂ and absorbs radiative heat in enclosed avionics racks [SLICE-001: 12.5% CO₂, SLICE-002: 18.0% CO₂]. At 100.0% O₂, requires ~36.0% local CO₂ concentration; crew must don O₂ masks to avoid hypercapnia (>2% cabin CO₂).

extinguishant_options.agent_name: Nitrogen (N₂) Dilution / Cabin Depressurization (Target <13.3% O₂)
extinguishant_options.mechanism_and_tradeoff: Reduces oxygen mole fraction below the 13.3% Limiting Oxygen Index [SLICE-003: 13.8% LOI] and starves convective O₂ transport when paired with HVAC fan shutdown (<1.5 cm/s).

extinguishant_options.agent_name: Halon Replacement (CF₃I / FK-5-1-12 Chemical Suppressant)
extinguishant_options.mechanism_and_tradeoff: Free-radical scavenging extinguishes 21% O₂ hydrocarbon flames [SLICE-005], but requires substantially higher agent concentration in ≥30% O₂ exploration atmospheres [SLICE-006] and generates toxic HF/HI acid gas decomposition products that poison ECLSS catalyst beds.

secondary_toxic_byproducts: Methyl Methacrylate (MMA) monomer vapor from depolymerizing acrylic (SOFIE / SAFFIRE-V)
Carbon Monoxide (CO) (SOFIE-003 peak 110 ppm; SAFFIRE-VI far-field plume)
post_fire_cleanup_steps: 1. Immediate Crew & Ventilation Action: Shut down inter-module HVAC ventilation fans (<1.5 cm/s) to induce diffusive flame quenching and halt far-field soot/CO migration [SAFFIREVI-S6-1], while crew dons Quick-Don Masks (QDMs) / Portable Breathing Apparatus (PBA).

2. Catalytic CO Oxidation (CatOx): Route cabin air through the Trace Contaminant Control Subassembly (TCCS) ambient/high-temp catalytic oxidizer to convert peak ~242 ppm CO into CO₂ until cabin CO drops below the 20 ppm 24-hr NASA SMAC [SAFFIREVI-S6-2].

3. Multi-Stage HEPA + Charcoal Particulate Scrubbing: Engage portable post-fire scrubber beds to capture sub-micron pyrolysis aerosols (0g CMD ~0.39 μm) before silica/soot chains foul primary ECLSS heat exchangers [SAME-AERO-004, SAMER-MSG-002].
4. Acid Gas & Monomer Polishing: Activate LiOH / activated-carbon acid-gas cartridges to strip Methyl Methacrylate prior to crew mask doffing [SAFFIREVI-S6-2].

detection_suppression.recommended_detector_modality: Dual-Wavelength Laser Scattering Photoelectric + CO Sensor (ISS / Orion Multi-Angle)
detection_suppression.detector_rationale: Grounded in SAME-AERO-001..015 and SAMER-MSG-001: Overheated Kapton wire pyrolysis in microgravity yields larger aerosol Count Median Diameter (CMD ~0.42 μm vs. ~0.14 μm in 1g) due to prolonged residence time and thermal coagulation in the absence of buoyant plumes, giving forward-scattering laser photoelectric detectors a 42% higher signal-to-noise ratio than legacy Shuttle Americium-241 ionization chambers.
detection_suppression.lunar_dust_discrimination_note: Grounded in DAFT-MSG-001 & DAFT2-MSG-002: In Artemis Lunar Surface Habitats & Pressurized Rovers (30.0% O₂, 70.3 kPa), suspended lunar regolith dust (JSC-1A / Highlands simulant >1.2 μm) triggers false alarms in single-channel optical detectors. Use DAFT M₁/M₀ aerosol moment-ratio discrimination to separate coarse regolith (>1.0 μm) from Overheated Kapton-Insulated Wire pyrolysis smoke (0g CMD ~0.42 μm).
detection_suppression.primary_extinguishant: De-Energize Bus + Portable CO₂ Flood (23.0% Vol) [SLICE-001 / SAME-AERO]
detection_suppression.secondary_extinguishant: Portable Fine Water Mist (ISS USOS / Orion PFE — safe after bus isolation) [SLICE-007]

extinguishant_options.agent_name: Fine Water Mist (ISS USOS / Orion Portable Fire Extinguisher)
extinguishant_options.mechanism_and_tradeoff: High latent heat of vaporization cools solid pyrolysis surfaces (PMMA, SIBAL, Nomex, Foam) without adding toxic cabin gas [SLICE-007, SLICE-008]. Avoid direct spray on unisolated high-voltage buses or pool liquid fuels.

extinguishant_options.agent_name: Carbon Dioxide (CO₂) Inerting Flood (23.0% Target Vol)
extinguishant_options.mechanism_and_tradeoff: Displaces O₂ and absorbs radiative heat in enclosed avionics racks [SLICE-001: 12.5% CO₂, SLICE-002: 18.0% CO₂]. At 30.0% O₂, requires ~23.0% local CO₂ concentration; crew must don O₂ masks to avoid hypercapnia (>2% cabin CO₂).

extinguishant_options.agent_name: Nitrogen (N₂) Dilution / Cabin Depressurization (Target <13.2% O₂)
extinguishant_options.mechanism_and_tradeoff: Reduces oxygen mole fraction below the 13.2% Limiting Oxygen Index [SLICE-003: 13.8% LOI] and starves convective O₂ transport when paired with HVAC fan shutdown (<1.5 cm/s).

extinguishant_options.agent_name: Halon Replacement (CF₃I / FK-5-1-12 Chemical Suppressant)
extinguishant_options.mechanism_and_tradeoff: Free-radical scavenging extinguishes 21% O₂ hydrocarbon flames [SLICE-005], but requires substantially higher agent concentration in ≥30% O₂ exploration atmospheres [SLICE-006] and generates toxic HF/HI acid gas decomposition products that poison ECLSS catalyst beds.

secondary_toxic_byproducts: Carbon Monoxide (CO) from aromatic polyimide pyrolysis (SAME mean 139.4 ppm, max 292.3 ppm)
Hydrogen Cyanide (HCN) trace emissions from imide ring cleavage above 550 °C
post_fire_cleanup_steps: 1. Immediate Crew & Ventilation Action: Shut down inter-module HVAC ventilation fans (<1.5 cm/s) to induce diffusive flame quenching and halt far-field soot/CO migration [SAFFIREVI-S6-1], while crew dons Quick-Don Masks (QDMs) / Portable Breathing Apparatus (PBA).

2. Catalytic CO Oxidation (CatOx): Route cabin air through the Trace Contaminant Control Subassembly (TCCS) ambient/high-temp catalytic oxidizer to convert peak ~162 ppm CO into CO₂ until cabin CO drops below the 20 ppm 24-hr NASA SMAC [SAFFIREVI-S6-2].

3. Multi-Stage HEPA + Charcoal Particulate Scrubbing: Engage portable post-fire scrubber beds to capture sub-micron pyrolysis aerosols (0g CMD ~0.42 μm) before silica/soot chains foul primary ECLSS heat exchangers [SAME-AERO-004, SAMER-MSG-002].
4. Acid Gas & Monomer Polishing: Activate LiOH / activated-carbon acid-gas cartridges to strip Carbon Monoxide prior to crew mask doffing [SAFFIREVI-S6-2].

evidence_experiments.key_insight: SAME-R reflight in ISS MSG confirmed microgravity pyrolysis aerosols have larger count median diameter (CMD ~0.42 um) than 1g smoke due to prolonged residence time, favoring laser-scattering photoelectric detection.
SAME investigation of smoke particulate size distribution and ionization/optical response in microgravity.

evidence_experiments.fuel_material: Lunar Highlands Dust Simulant + Pyrolysis Smoke Mix
evidence_experiments.key_insight: DAFT-2 validated dust-vs-smoke moment ratios (M1/M0 particle size discrimination) so Orion, Gateway, and Lunar Surface Habitat fire detectors distinguish coarse regolith (>1 um) from sub-micron pyrolysis smoke (<0.5 um).

evidence_experiments.fuel_material: Lunar Regolith Simulant (JSC-1A) vs Lampwick Smoke
evidence_experiments.key_insight: DAFT tested SAME aerosol instruments in ISS MSG with planetary dust simulants. Critical for Artemis Lunar Base & Pressurized Rover smoke detectors to prevent false fire alarms from suspended lunar regolith dust.
Higher suppressant concentration required in 30% O2 exploration atmosphere.
High aerodynamic co-flow induced blowoff extinction at 35 cm/s.

100.0|29.6|2.0.std6001_comparison: Artemis / Lunar Exploration Atmosphere regime (~34% O2, ~56.5 kPa): SOFIE and BASS-II show significantly lower Minimum Oxygen Concentration (MOC) extinction limits in low-velocity microgravity flow (3–15 cm/s) than 1g upward NASA-STD-6001 screening.
recommendations: Immediately shut off cabin ventilation fans upon smoke detection (reduces flow from 2.0 cm/s to ~0 cm/s to starve microgravity diffusion flames).
Elevated oxygen (100.0% O2) accelerates flame spread and lowers ignition energy; restrict exposed thin polymer/fabric geometries (PMMA, Cotton, Velcro).
Verify thickness and concurrent vs. opposed flow orientation against SAFFIRE I–VI and SOFIE data before qualifying cabin materials.

34.0|56.5|10.0.std6001_comparison: Artemis / Lunar Exploration Atmosphere regime (~34% O2, ~56.5 kPa): SOFIE and BASS-II show significantly lower Minimum Oxygen Concentration (MOC) extinction limits in low-velocity microgravity flow (3–15 cm/s) than 1g upward NASA-STD-6001 screening.
recommendations: Immediately shut off cabin ventilation fans upon smoke detection (reduces flow from 10.0 cm/s to ~0 cm/s to starve microgravity diffusion flames).
Elevated oxygen (34.0% O2) accelerates flame spread and lowers ignition energy; restrict exposed thin polymer/fabric geometries (PMMA, Cotton, Velcro).
Verify thickness and concurrent vs. opposed flow orientation against SAFFIRE I–VI and SOFIE data before qualifying cabin materials.

detection_suppression.recommended_detector_modality: Dual-Wavelength Laser Scattering Photoelectric + CO Sensor (ISS / Orion Multi-Angle)
detection_suppression.detector_rationale: Grounded in SAME-AERO-001..015 and SAMER-MSG-001: Overheated Kapton wire pyrolysis in microgravity yields larger aerosol Count Median Diameter (CMD ~0.42 μm vs. ~0.14 μm in 1g) due to prolonged residence time and thermal coagulation in the absence of buoyant plumes, giving forward-scattering laser photoelectric detectors a 42% higher signal-to-noise ratio than legacy Shuttle Americium-241 ionization chambers.
detection_suppression.lunar_dust_discrimination_note: Grounded in DAFT-MSG-001 & DAFT2-MSG-002: In Artemis Lunar Surface Habitats & Pressurized Rovers (34.0% O₂, 56.5 kPa), suspended lunar regolith dust (JSC-1A / Highlands simulant >1.2 μm) triggers false alarms in single-channel optical detectors. Use DAFT M₁/M₀ aerosol moment-ratio discrimination to separate coarse regolith (>1.0 μm) from Overheated PTFE-Insulated Wire (AWG 20) pyrolysis smoke (0g CMD ~0.42 μm).
detection_suppression.primary_extinguishant: De-Energize Bus + Portable CO₂ Flood (26.9% Vol) [SLICE-001 / SAME-AERO]
detection_suppression.secondary_extinguishant: Portable Fine Water Mist (ISS USOS / Orion PFE — safe after bus isolation) [SLICE-007]

extinguishant_options.agent_name: Fine Water Mist (ISS USOS / Orion Portable Fire Extinguisher)
extinguishant_options.mechanism_and_tradeoff: High latent heat of vaporization cools solid pyrolysis surfaces (PMMA, SIBAL, Nomex, Foam) without adding toxic cabin gas [SLICE-007, SLICE-008]. Avoid direct spray on unisolated high-voltage buses or pool liquid fuels.

extinguishant_options.agent_name: Carbon Dioxide (CO₂) Inerting Flood (26.9% Target Vol)
extinguishant_options.mechanism_and_tradeoff: Displaces O₂ and absorbs radiative heat in enclosed avionics racks [SLICE-001: 12.5% CO₂, SLICE-002: 18.0% CO₂]. At 34.0% O₂, requires ~26.9% local CO₂ concentration; crew must don O₂ masks to avoid hypercapnia (>2% cabin CO₂).

extinguishant_options.agent_name: Nitrogen (N₂) Dilution / Cabin Depressurization (Target <13.3% O₂)
extinguishant_options.mechanism_and_tradeoff: Reduces oxygen mole fraction below the 13.3% Limiting Oxygen Index [SLICE-003: 13.8% LOI] and starves convective O₂ transport when paired with HVAC fan shutdown (<1.5 cm/s).

extinguishant_options.agent_name: Halon Replacement (CF₃I / FK-5-1-12 Chemical Suppressant)
extinguishant_options.mechanism_and_tradeoff: Free-radical scavenging extinguishes 21% O₂ hydrocarbon flames [SLICE-005], but requires substantially higher agent concentration in ≥30% O₂ exploration atmospheres [SLICE-006] and generates toxic HF/HI acid gas decomposition products that poison ECLSS catalyst beds.

secondary_toxic_byproducts: Carbon Monoxide (CO) from aromatic polyimide pyrolysis (SAME mean 139.4 ppm, max 292.3 ppm)
Hydrogen Cyanide (HCN) trace emissions from imide ring cleavage above 550 °C
post_fire_cleanup_steps: 1. Immediate Crew & Ventilation Action: Shut down inter-module HVAC ventilation fans (<1.5 cm/s) to induce diffusive flame quenching and halt far-field soot/CO migration [SAFFIREVI-S6-1], while crew dons Quick-Don Masks (QDMs) / Portable Breathing Apparatus (PBA).

2. Catalytic CO Oxidation (CatOx): Route cabin air through the Trace Contaminant Control Subassembly (TCCS) ambient/high-temp catalytic oxidizer to convert peak ~172 ppm CO into CO₂ until cabin CO drops below the 20 ppm 24-hr NASA SMAC [SAFFIREVI-S6-2].

3. Multi-Stage HEPA + Charcoal Particulate Scrubbing: Engage portable post-fire scrubber beds to capture sub-micron pyrolysis aerosols (0g CMD ~0.42 μm) before silica/soot chains foul primary ECLSS heat exchangers [SAME-AERO-004, SAMER-MSG-002].
4. Acid Gas & Monomer Polishing: Activate LiOH / activated-carbon acid-gas cartridges to strip Carbon Monoxide prior to crew mask doffing [SAFFIREVI-S6-2].

evidence_experiments.key_insight: SAME-R reflight in ISS MSG confirmed microgravity pyrolysis aerosols have larger count median diameter (CMD ~0.42 um) than 1g smoke due to prolonged residence time, favoring laser-scattering photoelectric detection.

extinguishant_options.agent_name: Carbon Dioxide (CO₂) Inerting Flood (36.0% Target Vol)
extinguishant_options.mechanism_and_tradeoff: Displaces O₂ and absorbs radiative heat in enclosed avionics racks [SLICE-001: 12.5% CO₂, SLICE-002: 18.0% CO₂]. At 85.0% O₂, requires ~36.0% local CO₂ concentration; crew must don O₂ masks to avoid hypercapnia (>2% cabin CO₂).

extinguishant_options.agent_name: Nitrogen (N₂) Dilution / Cabin Depressurization (Target <12.9% O₂)
extinguishant_options.mechanism_and_tradeoff: Reduces oxygen mole fraction below the 12.9% Limiting Oxygen Index [SLICE-003: 13.8% LOI] and starves convective O₂ transport when paired with HVAC fan shutdown (<1.5 cm/s).

extinguishant_options.agent_name: Halon Replacement (CF₃I / FK-5-1-12 Chemical Suppressant)
extinguishant_options.mechanism_and_tradeoff: Free-radical scavenging extinguishes 21% O₂ hydrocarbon flames [SLICE-005], but requires substantially higher agent concentration in ≥30% O₂ exploration atmospheres [SLICE-006] and generates toxic HF/HI acid gas decomposition products that poison ECLSS catalyst beds.

post_fire_cleanup_steps: 1. Immediate Crew & Ventilation Action: Shut down inter-module HVAC ventilation fans (<1.5 cm/s) to induce diffusive flame quenching and halt far-field soot/CO migration [SAFFIREVI-S6-1], while crew dons Quick-Don Masks (QDMs) / Portable Breathing Apparatus (PBA).

2. Catalytic CO Oxidation (CatOx): Route cabin air through the Trace Contaminant Control Subassembly (TCCS) ambient/high-temp catalytic oxidizer to convert peak ~398 ppm CO into CO₂ until cabin CO drops below the 20 ppm 24-hr NASA SMAC [SAFFIREVI-S6-2].

3. Multi-Stage HEPA + Charcoal Particulate Scrubbing: Engage portable post-fire scrubber beds to capture sub-micron pyrolysis aerosols (0g CMD ~0.58 μm) before silica/soot chains foul primary ECLSS heat exchangers [SAME-AERO-004, SAMER-MSG-002].
4. Acid Gas & Monomer Polishing: Activate LiOH / activated-carbon acid-gas cartridges to strip Amorphous Silica prior to crew mask doffing [SAFFIREVI-S6-2].

detection_suppression.lunar_dust_discrimination_note: Grounded in DAFT-MSG-001 & DAFT2-MSG-002: In Artemis Lunar Surface Habitats & Pressurized Rovers (85.0% O₂, 101.3 kPa), suspended lunar regolith dust (JSC-1A / Highlands simulant >1.2 μm) triggers false alarms in single-channel optical detectors. Use DAFT M₁/M₀ aerosol moment-ratio discrimination to separate coarse regolith (>1.0 μm) from Flexible Polyurethane Foam (Open-Cell) pyrolysis smoke (0g CMD ~0.62 μm).
detection_suppression.primary_extinguishant: Portable Fine Water Mist Extinguisher (ISS USOS / Orion PFE) [SLICE-007 / SLICE-008]
detection_suppression.secondary_extinguishant: Concentrated CO₂ Flood (36.0% Vol Fraction) + Cabin Fan Cutoff [SLICE-002]

extinguishant_options.agent_name: Fine Water Mist (ISS USOS / Orion Portable Fire Extinguisher)
extinguishant_options.mechanism_and_tradeoff: High latent heat of vaporization cools solid pyrolysis surfaces (PMMA, SIBAL, Nomex, Foam) without adding toxic cabin gas [SLICE-007, SLICE-008]. Avoid direct spray on unisolated high-voltage buses or pool liquid fuels.

extinguishant_options.agent_name: Carbon Dioxide (CO₂) Inerting Flood (36.0% Target Vol)
extinguishant_options.mechanism_and_tradeoff: Displaces O₂ and absorbs radiative heat in enclosed avionics racks [SLICE-001: 12.5% CO₂, SLICE-002: 18.0% CO₂]. At 85.0% O₂, requires ~36.0% local CO₂ concentration; crew must don O₂ masks to avoid hypercapnia (>2% cabin CO₂).

extinguishant_options.agent_name: Nitrogen (N₂) Dilution / Cabin Depressurization (Target <12.8% O₂)
extinguishant_options.mechanism_and_tradeoff: Reduces oxygen mole fraction below the 12.8% Limiting Oxygen Index [SLICE-003: 13.8% LOI] and starves convective O₂ transport when paired with HVAC fan shutdown (<1.5 cm/s).

extinguishant_options.agent_name: Halon Replacement (CF₃I / FK-5-1-12 Chemical Suppressant)
extinguishant_options.mechanism_and_tradeoff: Free-radical scavenging extinguishes 21% O₂ hydrocarbon flames [SLICE-005], but requires substantially higher agent concentration in ≥30% O₂ exploration atmospheres [SLICE-006] and generates toxic HF/HI acid gas decomposition products that poison ECLSS catalyst beds.

secondary_toxic_byproducts: Severe Carbon Monoxide (CO) accumulation (MGM-ISS mean 284 ppm, peak 393.1 ppm)
Hydrogen Cyanide (HCN) & Isocyanate vapors from urethane bond pyrolysis
TCPP chlorinated phosphate retardant vapors (if flame-retarded foam)
post_fire_cleanup_steps: 1. Immediate Crew & Ventilation Action: Shut down inter-module HVAC ventilation fans (<1.5 cm/s) to induce diffusive flame quenching and halt far-field soot/CO migration [SAFFIREVI-S6-1], while crew dons Quick-Don Masks (QDMs) / Portable Breathing Apparatus (PBA).

2. Catalytic CO Oxidation (CatOx): Route cabin air through the Trace Contaminant Control Subassembly (TCCS) ambient/high-temp catalytic oxidizer to convert peak ~611 ppm CO into CO₂ until cabin CO drops below the 20 ppm 24-hr NASA SMAC [SAFFIREVI-S6-2].

3. Multi-Stage HEPA + Charcoal Particulate Scrubbing: Engage portable post-fire scrubber beds to capture sub-micron pyrolysis aerosols (0g CMD ~0.62 μm) before silica/soot chains foul primary ECLSS heat exchangers [SAME-AERO-004, SAMER-MSG-002].
4. Acid Gas & Monomer Polishing: Activate LiOH / activated-carbon acid-gas cartridges to strip Severe Carbon Monoxide prior to crew mask doffing [SAFFIREVI-S6-2].

3. Multi-Stage HEPA + Charcoal Particulate Scrubbing: Engage portable post-fire scrubber beds to capture sub-micron pyrolysis aerosols (0g CMD ~0.49 μm) before silica/soot chains foul primary ECLSS heat exchangers [SAME-AERO-004, SAMER-MSG-002].
4. Acid Gas & Monomer Polishing: Activate LiOH / activated-carbon acid-gas cartridges to strip Carbon Monoxide prior to crew mask doffing [SAFFIREVI-S6-2].

recommendations: Immediately shut off cabin ventilation fans upon smoke detection (reduces flow from 4.0 cm/s to ~0 cm/s to starve microgravity diffusion flames).

extinguishant_options.agent_name: Fine Water Mist (ISS USOS / Orion Portable Fire Extinguisher)
extinguishant_options.mechanism_and_tradeoff: High latent heat of vaporization cools solid pyrolysis surfaces (PMMA, SIBAL, Nomex, Foam) without adding toxic cabin gas [SLICE-007, SLICE-008]. Avoid direct spray on unisolated high-voltage buses or pool liquid fuels.

extinguishant_options.agent_name: Carbon Dioxide (CO₂) Inerting Flood (36.0% Target Vol)
extinguishant_options.mechanism_and_tradeoff: Displaces O₂ and absorbs radiative heat in enclosed avionics racks [SLICE-001: 12.5% CO₂, SLICE-002: 18.0% CO₂]. At 85.0% O₂, requires ~36.0% local CO₂ concentration; crew must don O₂ masks to avoid hypercapnia (>2% cabin CO₂).

extinguishant_options.agent_name: Nitrogen (N₂) Dilution / Cabin Depressurization (Target <13.0% O₂)
extinguishant_options.mechanism_and_tradeoff: Reduces oxygen mole fraction below the 13.0% Limiting Oxygen Index [SLICE-003: 13.8% LOI] and starves convective O₂ transport when paired with HVAC fan shutdown (<1.5 cm/s).

extinguishant_options.agent_name: Halon Replacement (CF₃I / FK-5-1-12 Chemical Suppressant)
extinguishant_options.mechanism_and_tradeoff: Free-radical scavenging extinguishes 21% O₂ hydrocarbon flames [SLICE-005], but requires substantially higher agent concentration in ≥30% O₂ exploration atmospheres [SLICE-006] and generates toxic HF/HI acid gas decomposition products that poison ECLSS catalyst beds.
